report.notes: R1-02: _win_launcher_target ignores REM/:: lines, refuses programs named cmd/powershell/pwsh/cscript/wscript and .bat/.cmd/.ps1/.vbs/.wsf scripts, and requires %* on the line that runs the program; npm shim shapes still bind. R2-01: _run and run_cmd catch OSError from communicate() after a successful spawn and still call containment.finish (job terminated and tracked; a failed termination keeps the job in _OPEN_JOBS so the next precheck fails closed). I did not register jobs at spawn time because the precheck inside drain_after_timeout would close a handle finish() still uses. R1-03 (test finding, not a regression file): test_lifecycle_windows_cli.py now asserts the launcher was found and the exact refusal reason; the .ps1 test also binds a .cmd beside it; added an npm-shim-with-comments test. All 11 tests in that file fail on ce1a90c on Linux (checked in a clean export); they pass on 0ee6885 as expected. R1-04: CAPABILITY_LEDGER marks Windows containment in a real milestone run NOT VERIFIED (windows_only unit tests owner-reported passed); URI_DEVELOPMENT_LIFECYCLE documents the W-2 identity (launcher/program/interpreter/launch) and the R1-02 refusal rules and narrows the re-check claim; LIFECYCLE_QUALIFICATION gets a dated correction note (history kept). The regression file's 11 tests all fail on 0ee6885 and pass after; full tests/dev_workflow: 238 passed, 5 skipped (windows_only, PLATFORM-GATED). The Windows code paths were checked only with the fake kernel32 and fixture launchers, not on Windows. graphify not run (coordinator rebuilds).
